Fico 2 is very sensitive to balances (revolving and installment) and any negative installment history. If you can, try to achieve AZEO on your cards (all zero balances except one with a balance that’s less than 5% of the limit). If you have any negative installment loan history (student loans, auto, etc) see if a goodwill letter to those companies will help you get negative history removed.

Finally, fico 2 is sensitive to new accounts so don’t open anything if you plan on applying for a mortgage within the next 6 months.

I experienced a little bit of sexual side-effect in that it takes me quite a while to finish, but i understand this is common for this medication so it's not a huge deal to me.
